name: YOUNG, Terry James

headline.note: The official parliamentary biography supplies a detailed private retail and franchise chronology from 1984 to 2019, corroborated by Young's first speech. It does not establish hours, leave, exact intra-year boundaries or substantive full-time status. The 2013-15 interval is unexplained, and Young said after election that he still owned two Drummond Golf franchises despite the official biography ending those roles in 2019. No documented full-time private-sector total is calculable; no pre-Parliament public-sector employment was found.

career_spells.evidence_note: The Parliamentary Handbook records a 1984 garage-attendant role. Young's career account says this service-station work lasted about one month while he sought an apprenticeship. Exact dates and hours are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is supported, but the short undated interval and hours are insufficient for a full-time duration.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official parliamentary biography records factory-hand work at James Saddlery in 1984. Exact dates, hours and leave are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is supported, but a duration cannot be calculated.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography records this 1984-86 retail role; Young's account corroborates progression from storeperson into sales. Exact appointment/cessation, hours and leave are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is supported, but full-time status and exact boundaries are insufficient.

career_spells.evidence_note: The Parliamentary Handbook records sales work from 1986 to 1988, corroborated by Young's first-person retail chronology. Exact boundaries, hours and leave are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is supported, but not a countable full-time interval.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography records this stage of Young's Chandlers progression. Exact transfer dates, hours and leave are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is supported, but duration evidence is insufficient.

career_spells.evidence_note: The Parliamentary Handbook records assistant-manager service from 1989 to 1991, and Young's first speech corroborates progression to management. Exact transfer dates, hours and leave are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: A management title alone does not prove full-time status; exact boundaries are also absent.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography records store management from 1991 to 1995. Young's first speech says he became a store manager at age 23 in Caboolture in 1991. Exact cessation, hours and leave are not published; a later speech refers to opening a Chandler store in Caboolture in 1992, which needs reconciliation with the employee title.
career_spells.counting_note: Private work is supported, but role/ownership details, full-time status and exact boundaries are unresolved.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography records this 1996-97 role. Exact appointment/transition, hours and leave are not published; the 1995-96 interval is not explained.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is supported, but the evidence required to calculate full-time years is absent.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography records this Philips management role in 1997-98. Exact transfer dates, hours and leave are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: A senior title does not establish substantive full-time status or exact duration.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography records account management in Philips DAP from 1998 to 2000. Exact boundaries, hours and leave are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is supported, but not a documented full-time interval.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography gives 2001-06. Young's first speech says he opened the Morayfield franchise in 2001 and later sold it. The exact 2006 sale date, entity structure, workload and leave are not published; the 2000-01 transition is unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Private self-employment is supported, but substantive full-time status and exact boundaries are not sufficiently evidenced.

career_spells.evidence_note: The Parliamentary Handbook records the Lawnton franchise from 2007 to 2012, and Young's first speech says he moved into golf retail after selling The Good Guys. Exact acquisition/sale, entity, workload and leave are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: Private self-employment is supported, but a full-time duration is not established.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography gives franchisee service from 2016 to 2019. In his 31 July 2019 first speech, after election, Young said he still retained ownership in two Drummond Golf franchises. The operational role, entity, hours, leave, campaign arrangements and actual ownership cessation are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Ownership does not by itself prove substantive full-time employment; the 2019 endpoint is disputed by the first-person account.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography gives a 2018-19 franchisee interval. Young's July 2019 statement that he retained ownership in two franchises indicates ownership continued after election or that the official year endpoint is imprecise. Operational work, entity, hours, leave and cessation are not established.
career_spells.counting_note: The role overlapped the Gosford franchise and ownership alone is not counted as full-time employment.

career_spells.role: Preselection candidate and federal candidate for Longman
career_spells.evidence_note: Contemporary reporting records unsuccessful preselection for the 2018 by-election and successful endorsement in November 2018 for the 2019 election. No paid party employment is established.
career_spells.counting_note: Candidate and party activity is excluded.

career_spells.role: Member of the House of Representatives for Longman
career_spells.evidence_note: The Parliamentary Handbook records election for Longman on 18 May 2019 and re-election in 2022 and 2025.

research_notes: Obtain exact commencement/cessation, hours and leave for every 1984-2000 employee role and resolve the 1995-96 and 2000-01 intervals.

Resolve whether the 1992 Chandler store reference denotes ownership, a store opening managed as an employee, or only imprecise recollection; identify employing entities across the Chandlers progression.
Obtain The Good Guys and each Drummond Golf entity, acquisition/sale dates, operational workload, leave and any co-owner arrangements; do not equate franchise ownership with full-time work.
Identify paid work or business activity in the unexplained 2013-15 interval.

Resolve the official 2019 endpoints for the Gosford and Maroochydore franchises against Young's 31 July 2019 statement that he retained ownership, and separate passive ownership from operational work after election.
Obtain preselection/campaign leave and paid-status evidence for 2018-19 party activity.
